issues.where: crops K and L, upper sunlit globe
issues.what: Fine crater rims and bright ejecta marks smear into diagonal streaks while the limb and background stars stay comparatively sharp.
issues.fix: Reduce the directional blur on the globe and retain enough texture resolution to resolve the crater rims in the close view.

issues.what: The terrain breaks into soft, chunky clumps at the rim; individual crater edges merge even though the stars just outside it remain distinct.
issues.fix: Render the grazing-angle terrain from higher-resolution relief and use anisotropic filtering to preserve detail along the limb.

issues.where: crops C and E, bright right limb
issues.what: A nearly uniform pale rim and amber halo wash out the last strip of surface detail, making the edge look like a separate layer.
issues.fix: Reduce the limb bloom and let its width and intensity vary with the underlying illumination.

issues.where: crops M and N, bright solar disk
issues.what: Large patches flatten to featureless white and lose the texture visible in the surrounding photosphere.
issues.fix: Roll off the brightest highlights and keep a trace of photospheric structure underneath the bloom.

issues.where: crop D, lower-left sky and dark globe
issues.what: The bright oblong flare ghost and faint polygonal echoes stand out from the much smaller stars.
issues.fix: Reduce the opacity of the flare ghosts or remove the brightest one so it does not read as a stray object.

issues.where: large crater, right half (crops E, F, R, W)
issues.what: the crater walls are drawn as smooth concentric swirls, like brush strokes, not slumped terraces and rubble; they read as painted or AI-made, and the swirl pattern repeats around the bowl
issues.fix: replace the swirl displacement with broken terrace and landslide geometry, plus scattered boulders and small craters on the walls

issues.where: shadowed crater interior, centre right (crops A, Q, H)
issues.what: the shadow is a flat, crushed black blob with no detail and no bounce light, and a small bright floating speck sits inside it (about x=750, y=410) like a stray object
issues.fix: add faint fill or earthshine so some floor relief shows, and remove the isolated bright speck

issues.where: night side of the globe, lower half (crops D, H, P, and T in image-16)
issues.what: the unlit disc is a smooth, even blue-grey fill that is lighter than space and ends in a crisp circular edge; it looks like a flat cut-out with no terrain and no gradual fade at the terminator
issues.fix: darken the night side to near black, or add very faint terrain detail, and soften the outer edge so it doesn't stand out as a pasted disc

issues.where: lit hemisphere, upper left and centre (crops B, F, J)
issues.what: the albedo looks airbrushed and blotchy, with soft colour clouds over the craters, and the bright ray system is overexposed into a glowing star shape
issues.fix: sharpen the albedo texture, cut back the soft colour washes and pull the highlight down on the ray crater

issues.where: plains in the near and middle ground (crops D, O, T, U)
issues.what: scattered single-pixel bright and coloured specks (white, blue, orange) sparkle on the regolith like glitter or noise
issues.fix: clamp specular fireflies and remove the coloured hot pixels from the surface

issues.where: upper left plains under the sun (crops B, G, P)
issues.what: faint streaky white smears across the surface look like a painted haze over the terrain, not ray material
issues.fix: remove the overlay streaks, or tie them to a real ray pattern coming from the crater

issues.where: dark sky (crops S to W in image-16)
issues.what: very faint vertical banding shows in the black background at native size
issues.fix: add dither to the background and render it at a higher bit depth
